articles.summary: BEIJING, June 05, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Yuanbao Inc. (“Yuanbao” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: YB), a leading technology-driven online insurance distributor in China, today announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025.
articles.title: Yuanbao Inc. Announces First Quarter 2025 Unaudited Financial Results
